text.en:
Advisory Board. An Advisory Board for the efficient management
of the Malacañang Heritage Mansions ("Advisory Board") is hereby created. The
Advisory Board shall be chaired by the Social Secretary, and shall be composed of
THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
7

three (3) representatives from the OP, who shall serve in ex officio capacity, and three
(3) representatives from the private sector who shall be appointed by the President.
The Advisory Board shall have the general function and responsibility of
formulating policies, projects, and programs for the efficient management of
Malacañang Heritage Mansions, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.
For this purpose, the Malacañang Heritage Mansions shall include the
Kalayaan Museum, and such other properties as may be identified by the Advisory

Transfer. The supervision of the Kalayaan Museum is hereby
transferred from the Office of the Deputy Executive Secretary for General
Administration to the Social Secretary's Office (SoSec).

Malacañang Heritage Mansions Management Center. The
Malacañang Heritage Mansions Management Center (MHMMC) is hereby established
to provide technical and administrative support to the Advisory Board. The MHMMC
shall be headed by an Executive Director tasked to ensure that the day-to-day
operations and maintenance of the subject properties are managed effectively,
efficiently and economically, as well as oversee its operational activities, including the
performance by all employees and personnel of their respective functions. The SoSec
shall likewise exercise administrative supervision over the MHMMC.

Organizational Structure and Staffing Pattern. The SoSec, in
coordination with the Office of the Deputy Executive Secretary for Finance and
Administration (ODESFA), shall: (a) determine the appropriate staffing pattern and
corresponding qualification standards for all positions necessary for the administration
and operations of the Malacañang Heritage Mansions; and (b) submit to the
Department of Budget and Management (DBM), for review and approval, the proposed
organizational structure and staffing pattern of the MHMMC, pursuant to this Order
and subject to compliance with relevant laws, rules and regulations.
Pending the approval of the proposed organizational structure and staffing
pattern of the MHMMC, the SoSec may tap into the existing manpower of the OP to
ensure the immediate implementation of this Order.

Revolving Fund. Consistent with policies and guidelines to be
promulgated by the Advisory Board, the Malacañang Heritage Mansions mav be
opened to the public as venue for special events, programs, and temporary
exhibitions, and appropriate fees may be charged for the purpose, subject to existing
laws, rules and regulations.
The proceeds of the operations of the Malacañang Heritage Mansions shall go
to a Revolving Fund which will be set up by the ODESFA, in coordination with the DBM
and the Bureau of the Treasury, in compliance with relevant budgeting, accounting
and auditing rules and regulations. Such Revolving Fund shall be used for the
maintenance, operation, preservation, restoration, and beautification of properties
covered by this Order.
2
7

Implementing Guidelines. Within thirty (30) working days from the
effectivity of this Order, the Advisory Board shall issue the necessary guidelines to
effectively implement this Order. The Advisory Board may request the assistance of
other relevant government agencies and offices in the formulation of the said
guidelines.

Funding. The funds necessary for the implementation of this Order
shall be charged against appropriate funding sources under the OP, subiect to relevant
budgeting, accounting, and auditing rules and regulations. Thereafter, the subsequent
funding requirements for the purpose shall be included in the budget proposal of the
OP, subject to the usual budget preparation process.

Separability. If any section or part of this Order is declared
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions not otherwise affected shall
remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof
that are inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 12th day of
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three
